semiconductor_relevance: High — TECNOS provides specialized equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in vacuum systems and powder management.
summary: TECNOS specializes in vacuum drying and outgassing systems, focusing on dry pumps that enhance the cleaning process to prevent restart failures. Their products include powder traps and filters designed for semiconductor CVD processes, as well as innovative tools like the Powder Killer for maintaining exhaust systems.
capabilities: Powder traps and filters for CVD processes
